method: five most recent distinct history songs; popularity fallback if necessary

cue_protocol.matching: maximum-weight one-to-one matching of five predicted cue sets to five target cue sets; edge score is within-item cue multiset F1
cue_protocol.draw: 10 fixed uniform draws of 40 cues from the distinct union of 15 history songs and five returned songs; partitioned in draw order into five eight-cue sets
cue_protocol.sparse_pool_rule: without replacement when pool has at least 40 distinct cues; otherwise with replacement only within that pool
